newsitem.title: USA: Ultradata Systems enters joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Ultradata Systems enters joint venture.

text.p: Ultradata Systems Inc, a provider of handheld electronic information systems, said Thursday it and American Clearing House signed a joint venture agreement targeting product development for the home delivery industry.
American Clearing provides database marketing and home delivery systems. It is based in Louisville, Ky.
Under terms of the agreement, American Clearing will work with Ultradata under an exclusive marketing arrangement to develop and sell "smart" products to facilitate home delivery.
Ultradata will be the exclusive provider of the electronic hardware delivery means for providing such services.
